quote: PROFILE = v; store.set(COURSE.ns + ':profile', v); S = loadState(); Q = null; EX = null; vData();
fix: Verified live: start an exam, leave to Progress, switch profile -> TICK keeps running and tick() throws 'Cannot read properties of null (reading ends)' every second forever. clearInterval(TICK) wherever EX is nulled (profile switch, import), or have tick() bail with `if (!EX) return clearInterval(TICK)`. Better: an `endExam()` helper that clears TICK and nulls EX, used by #setprof, #imp, #newx, #missx.

Verified live: on the 'Pass finished' / graph summary page Q.cur is still the last question with Q.answered=true, so every Enter press calls finish() again (st.n++, S.log.push, schedule) and re-runs quizDone; two presses added two log rows. Clicking the Quiz nav button after a finished pass (vQuiz -> renderQ) likewise re-shows the last card with live confidence buttons, so it can be recorded twice. Set a `Q.finished = true` in quizDone/graphDone and make renderQ/the keydown handler return (or render the done page) when it is set; or null Q after the done page and make vQuiz start fresh.

quote: const rerender = () => { ... else if (CUR === 'exam' && EX && !EX.done) renderExam(); else VIEWFN[CUR](); ...
fix: Verified live: on the exam result page EX.done is true, so clicking any ⚑ Flag in the review falls through to vExam(), which renders the exam setup page; the score/review is gone with no way back. Add `else if (CUR === 'exam' && EX && EX.done) examResult();` (or make vExam show examResult while EX.done and a 'New exam' click clears it).

where: renderQ/renderAll state split: Q (one-at-a-time) vs Q.st (all) plus Q.i for pass mode (228-236, 314-363, 374-402)
quote: if (S.layout === 'all') return renderAll(); const q = Q.cur;
fix: Verified live: in a pass drill shown 'All on one page', answer card 1 (recorded), click 'One at a time' -> card 1 (Q.cur, from the nextQ() call in startQuiz) is shown unanswered and can be answered and recorded a second time; switching the other way shows a question already answered in 'one' mode as fresh. Q.i also still points at 1 so pass mode re-walks questions answered in all mode. Make the two layouts share one answer-state map (Q.st keyed by id, with Q.cur's state = Q.st[Q.cur.id]), and in 'one' mode skip ids already answered in Q.st; or reset the drill (startQuiz again) on a layout switch and say so.

quote: const fin = $('#alldone'); if (fin) fin.onclick = () => { Q = null; go('topics'); };
fix: Verified live: a Graphs drill opened with the 'all' layout ends with Finish -> topics; graphDone() (the miss tally, 'Drill this figure again') never shows, so the Graphs feature's main payoff is missing in that layout. Route Finish through quizDone() (which already branches to graphDone) and only null Q from the done page; the same keeps the 'Pass finished' summary for ordinary drills.

Verified live: on the exam setup page, picking a length (e.g. 'All 659') and then clicking a layout chip re-runs vExam() through rerender(), which rebuilds the page and resets the length to the default (25) and the 'scale the clock' checkbox. Either keep `n`/scale in a module-level EXSET object that vExam reads back, or have the delegated handler only toggle the chips' `on` class when CUR==='exam' && !EX.

quote: st.conf = conf; const sq = qs(id); if (conf === 'guess') sq.ok = Math.max(0, sq.ok - 1); ... schedule(id, conf);
fix: checkAll already ran schedule(id,'sure') (box+1); downgrading to 'unsure' then runs schedule(id,'unsure') = max(1, box) on the already-raised box, so 'Not sure' after 'Knew it' keeps the lengthened interval, unlike the one-at-a-time flow. Remember the pre-answer box in st (st.box0) and restore it before rescheduling (st.box = st.box0; schedule(id, conf)).

BUTTON is not excluded, so a keyboard user who tabs to 'Not sure' or 'I guessed' and presses Enter gets e.preventDefault() plus finish('sure') — the choice is overridden and recorded as 'Knew it'; Enter on a focused ⚑ Flag or 'Check' button is likewise hijacked. Add BUTTON|A to the ignore list (or `if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.closest('button,a')) return;`).

where: layoutToggle (88), vTopics skill chips, vExam length chips, vTerms chips, vMap chips
fix: The chips are <span>s: not focusable, no role, no pressed state, so the layout preference (new) and the other chip controls cannot be reached by keyboard or screen reader. Render them as <button type="button" class="chip" aria-pressed="true|false"> (CSS already styles .chip; add `button.chip{font:inherit}`), and give the flag button aria-pressed as well (`flagBtn` has text, which is fine).

quote: function renderAllKeep() { const y = window.scrollY; renderAll(); window.scrollTo(0, y); }
fix: Every option click (including each checkbox toggle of a select-all item and every exam pick in the 'all' layout) rebuilds all 40 cards through innerHTML, including every data-URL figure ( from the 1.9 MB images.json) and every inline SVG; on a phone this is a visible stall and image re-decode per click. Re-render only the touched card: build its markup with qCard() and `card.replaceWith(...)` (or `card.outerHTML = ...`), and update the 'n of m answered' header text directly; rebind handlers via delegation on #view (data-qid/data-o are already there).

where: lastOutcome (721-726) called per question in vMap (811) and vGraphs (788, 802)
quote: for (let i = S.log.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (S.log[i].id === q.id) return S.log[i].ok ? 'right' : 'wrong';
fix: Each call walks S.log backwards; with 664 tiles and a log that grows to 5000 rows the map does up to ~3M comparisons per render (every filter chip click re-renders). Build a `last` map once per render in a single pass over S.log (`const last = {}; S.log.forEach(e => last[e.id] = e.ok)`) and read from it; vGraphs can do the same and also compute examPool() once instead of inside graphQs() for each of the 20 figures (missTally calls graphQs again, so 40 pool filters per render).

quote: const o = JSON.parse(t); if (!o.q) throw 0; S = o; save(); vData();
fix: An imported export from an older build has no flags/layout, so S.layout is undefined (neither layout chip shows as on; every `S.layout === 'all'` check is false, which works by luck) and S.flags is undefined. Normalize through the same code as loadState (factor a `normalize(s)` and call it in both places), and clear Q/EX (and TICK) on import as the profile switch does.

quote: $('#missx').onclick = () => { const m = qsx.filter(q => !exRight(q, EX.ans[q.id])); EX = null; startQuiz(m, 'Missed on the exam', 'sr'); };
fix: With a perfect score m is empty: EX is nulled, startQuiz alerts and returns, and the result page is left on screen with EX gone (a flag click then shows the setup page). Disable the button when nothing was missed, or null EX only after startQuiz succeeds.

`st = st || Q` is dead (every caller passes st) and hides a missing argument; drop it. `MISS[m][0]` throws if a bank file ever ships a miss tag not in MISS; test.js keeps its own MISS_TAGS copy, so the two lists can drift silently. Either guard (`(MISS[m] || [m, ''])`) or have test.js read the tag list from app.js (regex on `const MISS = {`), so the bank check enforces the app's list. The match question with an img (L06-013) is handled correctly everywhere (missTally/graphFeedback skip type==='match').

where: startGraph (775-779) and the Redo wrong handler (802)
fix: Q.graph is bolted on after startQuiz; if startQuiz ever returns early (empty list, caught here only by the preceding length check) `Q.graph = key` touches a stale or null Q. Give startQuiz an opts argument (`startQuiz(list, label, mode, {graph: key})`) so the drill is created whole and the two Graphs entry points stop duplicating the pattern.

Dead expression (always undefined); delete it and the `exe ?` branch. Add the three regressions found above as checks: Enter twice on 'Pass finished' leaves S.log unchanged; a flag click on the exam result page keeps 'Exam result' on screen; switching profile with an exam open produces no page errors (the harness already collects pageerror). Also cover the exam 'all' layout once (start, pick, submit) and the all-layout Finish of a graph drill reaching the tally page.

Consistent: every listed file exists, load.js parses both lists out of build.py so it cannot drift, and test.js/graph checks load graphs.js separately but through the same path. No action needed; only note that load.js's regex `\[[^\]]*\]` would break if a list is ever split with a comment containing ']'.
